scope: All four Batch executable test source sets
rootCause: Control Plane has 16 and Scheduler has 4 Mockito-based test classes but neither executable declares mockito-core in its own test dependency contract. Test dependencies of the shared testkit are not transitively inherited.
actualError: Control Plane compileTestJava reports package org.mockito does not exist and stops after 100 errors.
requiredFix: Declare the actually consumed Mockito test library in both owning executable builds, then compile and run every Batch executable suite.
prohibited: Do not skip tests, move production behavior into mocks, or make testkit leak implementation-only test dependencies.
